units.blurb: Listening, Reading and Use of Language

topics.name: Listening, Reading and Use of Language

connections.why: At AS, speaking and the receptive skills are assessed on the same theme content
AS reading and use-of-language work builds the grammatical accuracy needed for extended writing
AS spoken fluency and written production reinforce the same vocabulary and structures
The AS speaking assessment is the foundation for the more demanding A2 speaking discussion
AS listening and reading prepare learners for the harder, longer A2 receptive tasks
AS extended writing develops into the essay-based A2 extended writing on set works
Use-of-language grammar from AS underpins the accuracy of the A2 literature and film essays
At A2, speaking and the receptive skills share the same advanced theme and cultural content
A2 reading of set texts and films feeds the analytical essays in extended writing
A2 speaking and essay writing both require critical engagement with culture and set works
Structured argument practised in AS writing supports the spontaneous A2 discussion exam
The discussion technique built in AS speaking carries through to interrogating the advanced A2 reading texts
